title: 'It looked like a puddle': Tow truck driver kept busy by huge N.S. rainfall
description: Weekends are usually quiet for Tyson McEwan of McEwans Towing, but he has already recovered about 20 vehicles so far this weekend. The Havre Boucher, N.S., business is based in Antigonish County near the Canso Causeway.
text:

The Havre Boucher, N.S., business is based in Antigonish County near the Canso Causeway. Weekends are usually quiet for Tyson McEwan of McEwans Towing, but he has already recovered about 20 vehicles so far this weekend.

McEwan, whose Havre Boucher business is based in Antigonish County near the Canso Causeway, was in Halifax when the storm first hit. "I came home to my phone blowing up, having to go rescue people," he said Sunday morning. Cape Breton was hardest hit by the deluge, with more than 200 millimetres of rain falling over parts of the island.

One person was found dead in a flooded area near Cleveland, N.S. However, the mainland wasn't immune to heavy rain. One of McEwan's most notable rescues occurred in St.

แมคเอวาน ที่มีธุรกิจฮาเวอร์ บูเชอร์ ตั้งอยู่ที่อังกฤษ ใกล้ถนนแคนโซ คาเซเว่. "ฉันกลับบ้านและโทรศัพท์ของฉันระเบิด, ต้องไปช่วยคน", เขาพูดในเช้าวันอาทิตย์. จังหวัดเคปเบรตัน ได้รับผลกระทบหนักที่สุด จากน้ําท่วม โดยมีฝนตกมากกว่า 200 มิลลิเมตร.
